[[File:TzHaar-Hur chathead.png|left|95px]]
The '''TzHaar-Hur''' are inhabitants of the [[TzHaar city]]. As they are [[TzHaar]] crafters, they are unarmed and thus are the only TzHaar that do not drop obsidian weaponry. When initiating combat with them, they may occasionally use a signal animation of throwing a fiery flare up while [[retreat]]ing, causing nearby [[TzHaar-Ket]], [[TzHaar-Xil]], or [[TzHaar-Mej]] to become aggressive to the player to defend the TzHaar-Hur, saying {{RSChat|Kot kl, zek e JalYt!}} or {{RSChat|Kot e TzHaar-Hur!}}

The [[TzHaar mine]] from the quest [[TokTz-Ket-Dill]], contains 3 TzHaar-Hur which can be safely killed without interference from other TzHaar, although note that they attack with magic.
